properties.Name: The Great Barrier Reef Marine Park
properties.Description: Great Barrier Reef Marine Park Act of 1975 led to the Special Law for Galapagos legally establishing the Galapagos Marine Reserve in 1998.

properties.Name: Tsavo National Park
properties.Description: The Snow and Grimwood Report was presented to the Ecuadorian gov't.

properties.label: Yellowstone National Park - Wyoming, United States
properties.Name: Yellowstone National Park
properties.Description: The U.S. Tariff Act and Customs Order, mandated the confiscation of any Galapagos wildlife imported into the U.S. in violation of the Ecuadorian law. This was agreed enforcement of Ecuador's early Supreme Decree 31 which declared the islands as a national reserve.

properties.label: Floreana Island - Galápagos, Ecuador
properties.Name: Floreana Island
properties.Description: Home of the first Galapagos resident, Irishman Patrick Watkins.

properties.Name: The Inspiration Complex at the Charles Darwin Foundation
properties.Description: the governments of Ecuador and Germany, through the KfW Development Bank, signed a 5-year agreement that will fund the implementation of the program "Biodiversity Protection in the Galapagos Islands", for a total value of 15 million euros

properties.Name: Puerto Baquerizo Moreno
properties.Description: The administrative capital of the islands, excluded from the boundaries of the National Park.
properties.Deep Dive: July 14, 1959: creation of the national park, excluding 3% of the islands where human settlement already existed. February 18, 1973: the islands were declared an Ecuadorian province and given a desginated capital, bringing forth plans for infrastructure to encourage tourism as it was the primary economic source for residents.

properties.Name: Galapagos Academic Institute for the Arts and Sciences
properties.Description: Contributing data, research, and technology to determine important conservation policy changes.

properties.Name: Baltra Airport
properties.Description: One of the two commerical airports that regulate  incoming tourism, working to prevent incoming and outgoing traffic from harming the ecosystem.
